findings.desc: Antigravity is advertised as a first-class dispatch host with wrapped-preapply guard support via dispatch, but guard-session runtime still treats antigravity/agy as watcher-only. packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:268 and packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:277 state Antigravity gets wrapped-preapply through dispatch, and packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:2016 says viaDispatch applies to Codex/Antigravity. The actual resolver only includes codex and gemini in GUARD_WRAPPED_PREAPPLY_PROVIDERS at packages/main/src/core/guard-session.ts:62, so resolveGuardMode('antigravity',{viaDispatch:true}) falls through to watcher-fallback at packages/main/src/core/guard-session.ts:116. Verified by guard_session_start with provider=antigravity viaDispatch=true returning guardMode=watcher-fallback. This breaks the product semantics for first-class Antigravity host/runtime safety; add antigravity/agy to guard normalization or change the advertised capability/help before REVIEW can pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3cfbdeba3: guard-session normalization maps agy to antigravity and GUARD_WRAPPED_PREAPPLY_PROVIDERS includes antigravity, so guard_session_start/resolveGuardMode returns wrapped-preapply only when viaDispatch=true. Verified with guard_session_start for provider=antigravity and provider=agy.

findings.desc: docs/guide.md:7 still describes Lattice as built around Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI, and LLM APIs, but omits Antigravity/agy from the current CLI host set. host_list reports codex, claude-code, and antigravity host profiles, and host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity reports cliCommand=agy. The guide should state the current hosts as Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI/agy, with Gemini only legacy/deprecated, so user-facing text does not preserve pre-Antigravity semantics.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3cfbdeba3: docs/guide.md overview now names Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI (agy) as current CLI hosts, with Gemini retained only as deprecated legacy compatibility.

findings.desc: Antigravity prewrite-guard semantics and smoke coverage are incomplete. packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:268 and :277 advertise Antigravity as wrapped-preapply when invoked through Lattice dispatch, but packages/main/src/core/guard-session.ts:62-65 and :111-118 only grant wrapped-preapply to codex/gemini, so resolveGuardMode("antigravity", { viaDispatch: true }) still falls back to watcher-fallback. The existing smokes also still encode Gemini as the current profile/runtime list (packages/main/src/tasks/capability-list-smoke.ts:24-47, packages/main/src/tasks/dispatch-run-smoke.ts:260-280) while live capability_list/host_runtime_list now emit antigravity, so rebuilt validation will fail or miss the new agy path. Add antigravity/agy normalization to guard-session and update the smoke expectations to assert current Antigravity plus legacy Gemini compatibility separately.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 3cfbdeba3: guard-session adds Antigravity/agy wrapped-preapply normalization, capability-list smoke expects antigravity as current and agy alias separately, and dispatch-run smoke asserts antigravity/agy current runtime behavior while keeping Gemini legacy compatibility separate. Verified by npm build, capability-list-smoke, dispatch-run-smoke, guard_session_start, host_runtime_probe, and scope_contract_check.

findings.desc: docs/guide-scope-guard.md:17,34-35,208 still presents Gemini/gemini-cli as active current guard-provider paths and expected watcher-fallback agents, while omitting Antigravity CLI/agy from the current host semantics. After F-002, current hosts should be Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI/agy, with Gemini retained only as legacy/deprecated compatibility. This public guide therefore still teaches the pre-F-002 host model. Severity: high because the story goal is retiring Gemini-first semantics in user-facing docs.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in d8ad967c8: docs/guide-scope-guard.md now names Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI/agy as current guard/current host semantics, moves Gemini/gemini-cli to legacy/deprecated compatibility only, and adds Antigravity/agy dispatch guard examples. Verified with rg for Gemini/Antigravity wording in the touched docs, negative old-overclaim rg, git diff --check, and node bin/lattice.js scope_contract_check pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/host-guard-matrix-smoke.ts:11-12,117-153,228-267 still encodes Gemini as the wrapped-preapply guard/capability profile and never asserts the current Antigravity/agy guard semantics. This is a real failing verification path after B-d674 removed Gemini from the current capability host list: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/host-guard-matrix-smoke.js` exits with TypeError at dist/tasks/host-guard-matrix-smoke.js:139 because `buildCapabilityList()` no longer returns a gemini profile. That contradicts the concept contract for this story: current third-host semantics are Antigravity/agy, while Gemini is legacy compatibility only. Update the smoke to assert antigravity and agy wrapped-preapply behavior, keep Gemini only as explicit legacy compatibility if needed, and align the stale GuardSessionMode comment in packages/main/src/core/types.ts:1654 so guard semantics have one current model.
